reasons.plausibility: Ga doping is known to induce local lattice distortions in Fe-based alloys and could plausibly increase coercivity, though the exact BCC formation and anisotropy effects are not fully certain.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison experiment with and without Ga addition, including phase analysis and magnetic measurements, provides a direct falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: Proposing Ga doping as a straightforward route to improve coercivity in an FeCoNi-based system is a practical idea worth pursuing experimentally.
